editor.label: OPKSSH
editor.description: 使用身份提供商登录此主机，而非密码或密钥。需要在服务器上设置 OPKSSH。

dialog.title: 需要 OPKSSH 认证
dialog.description: 在浏览器中完成认证以继续。此会话将在 24 小时内有效。

errors.authFailed: 认证失败，请检查凭据并重试。

redirectUri.label: Redirect URI
redirectUri.description: Register this URL as an allowed redirect URI with every identity provider in your OPKSSH config.

legacyCallback.label: Use the old redirect URI
legacyCallback.description: Keep sending /host/opkssh-callback, the redirect URI used before 2.9. Turn this off once your identity providers allow the new one.
